real_defects.issue: Eleven escapers (coi-expiry-gap-checker, einvoice-preflight mandate-calendar, invoice-payment-terms-calculator calendar+reminders, late-invoice-collections-kit, meeting-action-items, saas-renewal-planner, slot-keeper, vcard-contacts-check, vegetable-garden-planting-calendar, wedding-day-timeline-builder) used .replace(/;/g, "\;"); in JS that string is ';', so semicolons in SUMMARY/DESCRIPTION/FN were never escaped (RFC 5545 3.3.11, RFC 6350 3.4). Four tests asserted the bug because the regex /\;/ also matches a bare ';'. Fixed to "\\;", tests corrected, einvoice mandate-calendar.ics regenerated (its X-WR-CALDESC too).

toIcs put the user's crew name into SUMMARY with no escaping at all (a ',' or ';' unescaped, a newline splits the property) and into UID raw. SUMMARY now escaped; newlines stripped from UID (other characters kept so existing UIDs stay stable).
